purpose: development and extraction evaluation, not model training
selection_bias: Convenience pilot; CORD dominates and is not representative of UK Costco users
grouping: Same SHA256 or canonical upstream gt_parse share a transaction group; cross-split duplicates excluded; dHash flags require visual adjudication

item_matching.normalization: Unicode alphanumeric lowercase; quantity prefixes removed

money.representation: integer minor units via Python Decimal; no tolerance; no balancing edits
money.IDR_note: Printed integer rupiah are whole major units. Dot/comma three-digit grouping is not a decimal fraction.

unknown_values: null and review flag; not zero; omitted from relevant metric denominator
metrics: scanner reconciliation failures and unavailable checks
test_policy: No scanner changes based on held-out results. Inspect test images only for origin, rights and quality; run frozen baseline once. Later tuning requires a fresh evaluation set.
